nom: The Ordinary Marine Hyaluronic Moisture Lock Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the serum as lightweight and non-greasy, saying it hydrates without adding shine, clogging pores, or worsening oiliness, and several use it as a base before retinol.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin frequently report a boost in hydration and plumpness, especially in low-humidity climates, though a few say it made no noticeable difference and one describes it as feeling like water with no lasting moisture.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin pairs it with a retinoid that controls oily patches, and finds the serum keeps the rest of her face hydrated and glowing.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally tolerate the serum well, several noting it doesn't irritate where other hyaluronic acid products do, though one with a shellfish allergy had a severe allergic reaction and another developed a reaction to an ingredient after around two years of regular use.
segments.mature: A 77-year-old reviewer credits the serum with plump, firm-looking skin, and another describes healthier, less-old-looking skin after struggling with dryness.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report plumper, firmer-looking skin and reduced fine lines, including a 77-year-old citing visible firmness and one noting malar bag (under-eye) reduction; one reviewer used it three months hoping to reduce fine lines without noticing a difference.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with dehydrated or dry skin, including in very low-humidity climates, report a marked increase in hydration and plumpness; several others found no noticeable effect and describe it as feeling like water on the skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the serum with restoring her skin barrier alongside fading acne scars; another reports the opposite, saying it gave her eczema-like patches she had never had before.
concerns.spots: One reviewer explicitly credits the serum with fading acne scars as her skin barrier improved; another describes reduced scarring after introducing it as part of a broader Ordinary skincare routine.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or cystic-acne-prone skin say it did not cause breakouts and describe it as gentle and non-irritating; a smaller number report new breakouts or small eczema-like patches, including one whose face improved again once she stopped using it.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it hydrates without adding shine or clogging pores and works well before retinol; one reviewer found it too much when layered with a separate moisturizer in summer and switched to using it only on her lips.

extraits.titre: Did more harm than good for me
extraits.texte: I wanted to try this out after finally throwing out the hyaluronic acid serum, which never made any difference, but unfortunately this one was even worse for me. Not only did it not help with skin hydration at all as far as I can tell, but it also broke me out and gave me small eczema patches - I've never had eczema before, so that was extremely disappointing. Considering I've used all other products in my routine consistently for a month by now, it's really the only product that could've caused this. Not sure why my skin reacted the way it did, normally I can tolerate pretty much anything. Ah well.

I grabbed this product after reading the rave reviews. What I failed to do before purchasing it was to carefully read the product description. It is VERY lightweight, and while it is causing my skin no harm, it isn't doing anything for it, either. Like, nothing AT ALL. I've used it for over a month now on my dry and mature skin, and, well, crickets. So I guess it's not a miracle serum for everybody. I'm giving it two stars since it's not causing any problem, and maybe, just maybe, it IS doing something but so subtle that it's not noticeable.

extraits.titre: Great product but NOT for me.
extraits.texte: I bought the product on April 29th and retuned it on May 2nd. It was the only new product that added to my regimen and I immediately got multiple breakouts on my chin. I could feel them forming as the day went on. Not sure why my face reacted the way that it did, when everyone I know of had good luck with it. And besides that it did make my sensitive and dry face feel good. Just with breakouts. Face improved the minute I stopped 😞 I would recommend to others. Just not right for my skin.

extraits.titre: Applies like foamy water. Lightweight and workable
extraits.texte: I was not expecting this product to be the consistency of water, it kind of put me off at first. I live in extreme low humidity (under 10% most of the year) and heavy humectants do more damage than benefit. I use an absurd amount of this stuff layering everyday on wet skin and I seal it in with heavy occlusives. I've seen a significant difference around my lips. It's immediately noticable. I like it. I have very dry sensitive/reactive skin, but this product never irritated me. I recommend using it as a base layer for hydration, or for oily skin types in normal weather conditions.

I live in a dry extremely low humidity climate so hyaluronic acid is not an ideal option due to its moisture-pulling nature that further drys out my skin. However, I have discovered that this serum works WONDERS on my dehydrated and dry skin. It has noticeably reduced my acne, leaving my face remarkably smooth. My skin now feels healthy and revitalized, appearing plump instead of dried out. Think of a dried out dish sponge vs a soaked dish sponge haha. On occasion, I use The Ordinary's rosehip oil between the Marine serum and my moisturizer, resulting in remarkably smooth skin. ;) I love the consistency of this serum as well it's incredibly easy to work with and a little goes a long way. I also love that this serum is in a dropper bottle, but my only con is that there isn't a bigger size of this serum. Please release a bigger bottle of this serum. If you live in a humid environment HA is the way to go, if you live in a low humidity environment an option such as this Marine serum is the way to go.

extraits.titre: I would literally die without it its so good
extraits.texte: Ok so this was the first TO product I tried and it didnt disappoint--many ppl said this is better in consistency than their HA serum and doesn't pill and while I can't compare them since I havent used the latter, I can confirm it doesnt pill and it provide long-lasting deep hydration. it has so many humectants in it that maintain the moisture in your skin as well as salicylic acid which is an exfoliant and overall has a better ingredient list than the HA serum with a little to no chance of irritation (unless you're allergic to ingredients derived from the ocean) Overall its so amazing and my skins been so happy and hydrated after using it (and I feel like it really hydrates deep within the skin cuz after I wake up and wash my face its still hydrated and soft) its so affordable as well which is a bonus especially because the formula is so much better than some higher end products. It's so hard to find serums that don't irritate my skin (I'm extremely acne prone and used to have really bad cystic acne) but this is so gentle and non-irritating. I just repurchased it!

It is a nightmare to find products that work for my skin because 1. it's so fussy to ingredients 2. it's hard to find something that addresses all my skin types/issues which are: dehydrated, combo leaning oily, easily congested , acne prone, sensitive and hyper pigmentation. For some reason hyaloronic scid just never really worked for me, in fact it felt like it was absorbing all the water from my skin rather than than the environment and products and my skin would just look dull and dry. Having used this serum I have seen major changes, it seems to help to retain hydration and restore my skin barrier as my acne scars that I've had for months a slowly fade away. I know it's this serum because it's the only thing I've changed in my routine.
